# HomeLet

> > HomeLet provides tenant referencing (VISTA), landlord insurance, rent guarantee products, and the HomeLet Rental Index for the UK private rental sector.

HomeLet serves landlords, letting agents, and tenants with comprehensive services including tenant referencing, landlord insurance products, rent guarantee cover, and market intelligence through their Rental Index. The site provides extensive guidance on compliance with UK housing legislation including the Renters' Rights Act and Section 21 abolition.

## Key Topics

- VISTA tenant referencing
- HomeLet Rental Index
- Renters' Rights Act
- Section 21 abolition
- Rent Guarantee Insurance
- Landlord Liability Insurance
- Tenant referencing process
- UK rental market data
- Regional rental prices
- Letting agent compliance
- Tenancy fraud prevention
- End of tenancy procedures
- HMO licensing
- Build to Rent (BTR) sector
- Legal for Lettings

## Renters' Rights & Compliance

- [The Renters' Rights Act | HomeLet](https://homelet.co.uk/letting-agents/knowledge-hub/renters-rights-bill): Comprehensive guide to Renters' Rights Act for letting agents
- [The Renters' Rights Bill | HomeLet](https://homelet.co.uk/letting-agents/knowledge-hub/copy-of-renters-rights-bill): Letting agent guide to Renters' Rights Bill and Section 21 abolition
- [Letting Agent Expert Tips & Guides | HomeLet](https://homelet.co.uk/letting-agents/knowledge-hub/tips-and-guides): Expert tips covering tenant referencing and Renters' Rights Act compliance
